RULING ON MOTORHAZTETO-ELV, since the caller asked for a settled term: it is an ERROR and should be written solid as motorhaztetoelv. The two cited precedents do not cover it - Bollinger-kozepvonal is hyphenated because Bollinger is a proper noun (AkH 168) and chokepoint-aritmetika because chokepoint is an unassimilated foreign element (AkH 138), whereas motor-haz-teto-elv is four native common elements, i.e. a tobbszoros osszetetel governed by AkH 139, which hyphenates only when the word is LONGER than six syllables. At exactly six it is not longer, so solid is mandated - the author's own six-syllable count is the fact that decides against the hyphen, not for it. The report's internal practice agrees: Konfluenciaszabaly (L70) and now Savhatarszabaly (L163) are both solid. WHY THIS DOES NOT HOLD THE ITEM AT HALF: the item's named bar is zero typos and agreement errors, and those are now genuinely zero; the prior half was carried by a six-instance mistranslation, two broken sentences and two compound errors, of which one boundary-case compound remains. Two lexical residuals also survive and are recorded, not deducted, because they are register choices rather than errors: berpapir for payrolls (L33, L130, L136, L149, L177) and rubrikank (L154), where Hungarian rubrika means a column or box. Scoring one marginal compound as equivalent to the prior eleven defects would make the item non-discriminating in the opposite direction.
